title.zh: 卷一 本紀第一: 高祖
title.raw: 卷一 本紀第一: 高祖 Volume 1 Annals 1: Gaozu

sentences.zh: 高祖高祖神堯大聖大光孝皇帝，姓李氏，諱淵。

translations.literal: Gaozu Gaozu, Emperor Shenyao the Great Sage, Greatly Glorious and Filial, bore the surname Li; his taboo personal name was Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu Gaozu, styled Emperor Shenyao the Great Sage, Greatly Glorious and Filial, was of the Li clan; his personal name was Yuan.

sentences.zh: 其先隴西狄道人，凉武昭王暠七代孫也。

translations.literal: His forebears were men of Didao in Longxi, seventh-generation descendants of Lü Wu Zhaowang Hao.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors came from Didao in Longxi—seventh in descent from Lü Wu Zhaowang Hao.

sentences.zh: 暠生歆，歆生重耳，仕魏為弘農太守。

translations.literal: Hao begat Xin; Xin begat Chong'er, who served Wei as Administrator of Hongnong.
translations.idiomatic: Hao had a son Xin; Xin had a son Chong'er, who served the Wei as Administrator of Hongnong.

sentences.zh: 重耳生熙，為金門鎮將，領豪傑鎮武川，因家焉。

translations.literal: Chong'er begat Xi, who was a garrison commander at Jintun, leading the bold to hold Wuchuan, and there made his home.
translations.idiomatic: Chong'er had a son Xi, who served as commandant of the Jintun garrison, leading local champions to secure Wuchuan, where the family settled.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳中，追尊宣皇帝。

translations.literal: In the Yifeng era he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yifeng reign he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 熙生天錫，仕魏為幢主。

translations.literal: Xi begat Tianshi, who served Wei as a standard-bearer chief.
translations.idiomatic: Xi had a son Tianshi, who served the Wei as a chief of standard-bearers.

sentences.zh: 大統中，贈司空。

translations.literal: In the Datong era he was posthumously granted the office of Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the Datong era he was posthumously granted the title Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳中，追尊光皇帝。

translations.literal: In the Yifeng era he was posthumously honored as Emperor Guang.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yifeng reign he was posthumously honored as Emperor Guang.

sentences.zh: 皇祖諱虎，後魏左僕射，封隴西郡公，與周文帝及太保李弼、大司馬獨孤信等以功參佐命，當時稱為「八柱國家」，仍賜姓大野氏。

translations.literal: The imperial grandfather, taboo name Hu, was Vice Minister of the Left in Later Wei and Duke of Longxi Commandery; with Zhou Wendi and the Grand Tutor Li Bi, the Grand Marshal Dugu Xin, and others he aided the founding by merit and was then styled among the "Eight Pillar Families," and was moreover granted the surname Daye.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's grandfather, personal name Hu, served as Vice Minister of the Left under the Later Wei and was enfeoffed as Duke of Longxi. With Zhou Wendi, Grand Tutor Li Bi, Grand Marshal Dugu Xin, and others he helped establish the dynasty by merit and was acclaimed as one of the "Eight Pillar Families"; he was also granted the surname Daye.

sentences.zh: 周受禪，追封唐國公，謚曰襄。

translations.literal: When Zhou received the abdication, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Tang and given the posthumous title Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou received the abdication, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Tang with the posthumous title Xiang.

sentences.zh: 至隋文帝作相，還復本姓。

translations.literal: When Sui Wendi became regent, he restored the original surname.
translations.idiomatic: When Sui Wendi became regent, the family surname was restored.

sentences.zh: 武德初，追尊景皇帝，廟號太祖，陵曰永康。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wude he was posthumously honored as Emperor Jing, temple name Taizu, tomb Yongkang.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Wude era he was posthumously honored as Emperor Jing, with temple name Taizu and tomb Yongkang.

sentences.zh: 皇考諱昞，周安州總管、柱國大將軍，襲唐國公，謚曰仁。

translations.literal: The imperial father, taboo name Bing, was Zhou's General-in-Chief of Anzhou and Pillar General, succeeding as Duke of Tang, posthumous title Ren.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's father, personal name Bing, was General-in-Chief of Anzhou and a Pillar General under the Zhou, inherited the Dukedom of Tang, and bore the posthumous title Ren.

sentences.zh: 武德初，追尊元皇帝，廟號世祖，陵曰興寧。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wude he was posthumously honored as Emperor Yuan, temple name Shizu, tomb Xingning.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Wude era he was posthumously honored as Emperor Yuan, with temple name Shizu and tomb Xingning.

sentences.zh: 高祖以周天和元年生於長安，七歲襲唐國公。

translations.literal: Gaozu was born in Chang'an in the first year of the Zhou Tianhe era; at seven he inherited the Dukedom of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu was born in Chang'an in the first year of Tianhe under the Northern Zhou; at age seven he inherited the Dukedom of Tang.

sentences.zh: 及長，倜儻豁達，任性真率，寬仁容眾，無貴賤咸得其歡心。

translations.literal: When grown he was bold and open, willful and sincere, generous and embracing the multitude; noble and base alike found favor with him.
translations.idiomatic: When he came of age he was bold and open-hearted, willful yet sincere, generous and inclusive; high and low alike took delight in him.

sentences.zh: 隋受禪，補千牛備身。

translations.literal: When Sui received the abdication, he was appointed Thousand-Ox Guard attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sui received the abdication, he was appointed an attendant of the Thousand-Ox Guard.

sentences.zh: 文帝獨孤皇后，即高祖從母也，由是特見親愛，累轉譙、隴、岐三州刺史。

translations.literal: Empress Dugu of Wendi was Gaozu's maternal aunt; for this he was especially cherished, and he was repeatedly transferred as prefect of Qiao, Long, and Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dugu, consort of Wendi, was Gaozu's aunt on his mother's side; he was therefore especially favored and rose through appointments as prefect of Qiao, Long, and Qi.

sentences.zh: 有史世良者，善相人，謂高祖曰：「公骨法非常，必為人主，願自愛，勿忘鄙言。

translations.literal: There was one Shi Shiliang, skilled at physiognomy, who said to Gaozu: "Your bone structure is extraordinary; you are certain to become a sovereign. I beg you cherish yourself—do not forget my humble words.
translations.idiomatic: A physiognomist named Shi Shiliang told Gaozu, "Your bone structure is extraordinary—you are destined to rule. Cherish yourself, and do not forget what I have said."

sentences.zh: 」高祖頗以自負。

translations.literal: " Gaozu was quite proud on this account.
translations.idiomatic: After this Gaozu grew quite proud.

sentences.zh: 大業初，為滎陽、樓煩二郡太守，徵為殿內少監。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Daye era he was prefect of Xingyang and Loufan, then summoned as Vice Director of the Palace Internal.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Daye era he served as prefect of Xingyang and Loufan, then was summoned as Vice Director of the Palace Internal.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷衛尉少卿。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was moved to Vice Minister of the Commandant of the Guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of the Commandant of the Guards.

sentences.zh: 遼東之役，督運於懷遠鎮。

translations.literal: In the Liaodong campaign he supervised transport at Huaiyuan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: During the Liaodong campaign he oversaw supply transport at Huaiyuan Garrison.

sentences.zh: 及楊玄感反，詔高祖馳驛鎮弘化郡，兼知關右諸軍事。

translations.literal: When Yang Xuangan rebelled, an edict ordered Gaozu to ride post-horses to secure Honghua Commandery and concurrently oversee military affairs west of the passes.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Xuangan rose in rebellion, an edict ordered Gaozu to ride post relays to secure Honghua Commandery and take concurrent command of military affairs west of the passes.

sentences.zh: 高祖歷試中外，素樹恩德，及是結納豪傑，眾多款附。

translations.literal: Gaozu had long been tested in central and outer posts and had steadily planted favor; now he drew in the bold, and many pledged themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu had served in posts throughout the empire and had long cultivated goodwill; now he gathered bold men, and many pledged their loyalty.

sentences.zh: 時煬帝多所猜忌，人懷疑懼。

translations.literal: At that time Yangdi was much given to suspicion, and men harbored fear.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Yang was deeply suspicious, and men lived in fear.

sentences.zh: 會有詔徵高祖詣行在所，遇疾未謁。

translations.literal: There came an edict summoning Gaozu to the imperial camp; he fell ill and did not attend audience.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then summoned Gaozu to the imperial camp; he fell ill and did not present himself.

sentences.zh: 時甥王氏在後宮，帝問曰：「汝舅何遲？

translations.literal: At that time his maternal nephew, the Lady Wang, was in the inner palace; the Emperor asked, "Why is your uncle so late?
translations.idiomatic: His maternal nephew Lady Wang was then in the inner palace. The Emperor asked her, "Why is your uncle so slow in coming?

sentences.zh: 」王氏以疾對，帝曰：「可得死否？

translations.literal: " The Lady Wang answered that he was ill; the Emperor said, "Can he die?
translations.idiomatic: " She replied that he was ill. The Emperor said, "Can he simply die?"

sentences.zh: 」高祖聞之益懼，因縱酒沉湎，納賄以混其跡焉。

translations.literal: " When Gaozu heard this he grew still more afraid, and therefore drowned himself in wine and paid bribes to blur his tracks.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu heard this he grew still more afraid; he drowned himself in wine and paid bribes to obscure his intentions.

sentences.zh: 十一年，煬帝幸汾陽宮，命高祖往山西、河東黜陟討捕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Yangdi visited Fenyang Palace and ordered Gaozu to go to Shanxi and Hedong to investigate, promote, and punish, and to pursue bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Emperor Yang visited Fenyang Palace and ordered Gaozu to Shanxi and Hedong to conduct inspections and pursue bandits.

sentences.zh: 師次龍門，賊帥毋端兒帥眾數千薄於城下。

translations.literal: When the army halted at Longmen, the bandit chief Wu Duan'er led several thousand men to press upon the city.
translations.idiomatic: When the army halted at Longmen, the bandit chief Wu Duan'er led several thousand men against the city.

sentences.zh: 高祖從十餘騎擊之，所射七十發，皆應弦而倒，賊乃大潰。

translations.literal: Gaozu with a dozen horsemen attacked them; of seventy arrows he loosed, each struck its target and the man fell; the bandits were routed in great disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu attacked with barely a dozen horsemen. Of seventy arrows he loosed, each found its mark and a man fell; the bandits broke and fled in disorder.

sentences.zh: 十二年，遷右驍衛將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was transferred to General of the Right Valiant Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was appointed General of the Right Valiant Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 十三年，為太原留守，郡丞王威、武牙郎將高君雅為副。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was garrison commander of Taiyuan; the assistant prefect Wang Wei and the martial guard officer Gao Junya served as his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he became garrison commander of Taiyuan, with Assistant Prefect Wang Wei and Martial Guard Officer Gao Junya as deputies.

sentences.zh: 群賊蜂起，江都阻絕，太宗與晉陽令劉文靜首謀，勸舉義兵。

translations.literal: Bandits rose everywhere like bees; communications with Jiangdu were cut. Taizong and the magistrate of Jinyang, Liu Wenjing, were first to plot and urge raising the righteous army.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits swarmed on every side; the road to Jiangdu was cut. Taizong and Liu Wenjing, magistrate of Jinyang, were the first to plot and urge an uprising.

sentences.zh: 俄而馬邑校尉劉武周據汾陽宮舉兵反，太宗與王威、高君雅將集兵討之。

translations.literal: Before long the garrison commandant of Mayi, Liu Wuzhou, seized Fenyang Palace and rose in rebellion; Taizong with Wang Wei and Gao Junya were about to gather troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Liu Wuzhou, garrison commandant of Mayi, seized Fenyang Palace and rebelled; Taizong, Wang Wei, and Gao Junya prepared to gather troops against him.

sentences.zh: 高祖乃命太宗與劉文靜及門下客長孫順德、劉弘基各募兵，旬日間眾且一萬，密遣使召世子建成及元吉於河東。

translations.literal: Gaozu then ordered Taizong, Liu Wenjing, and his retainers Sun Shunde and Liu Hongji each to recruit soldiers; within ten days their forces approached ten thousand, and he secretly sent messengers to summon the heir Jiancheng and Yuanji from Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu ordered Taizong, Liu Wenjing, and retainers Sun Shunde and Liu Hongji each to raise troops; within ten days they mustered nearly ten thousand men, and he secretly summoned the heir Jiancheng and Yuanji from Hedong.

sentences.zh: 威、君雅見兵大集，恐高祖為變，相與疑懼，請高祖祈雨於晉祠，將為不利。

translations.literal: Wei and Junya, seeing the armies massed, feared Gaozu would turn against them; they grew suspicious together and asked Gaozu to pray for rain at the Jin Shrine, intending harm.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the armies massed, Wei and Junya feared Gaozu would rebel; suspicious, they asked him to pray for rain at the Jin Shrine, planning treachery.

sentences.zh: 晉陽鄉長劉世龍知之，以告高祖，高祖陰為之備。

translations.literal: The district elder of Jinyang, Liu Shilong, learned of it and told Gaozu; Gaozu secretly made ready.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shilong, district elder of Jinyang, learned of the plot and informed Gaozu, who quietly prepared his defenses.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，高祖與威、君雅視事，太宗密嚴兵於外，以備非常。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi of the fifth month, Gaozu sat in council with Wei and Junya; Taizong secretly arrayed troops outside to guard against the unexpected.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the fifth month, Gaozu held court with Wei and Junya while Taizong secretly deployed troops outside against any surprise.

sentences.zh: 遣開陽府司馬劉政會告威等謀反，即斬之以徇，遂起義兵。

translations.literal: He sent the Kaiyang Prefecture marshal Liu Zhenghui to accuse Wei and the others of treason, and at once beheaded them as a warning; then he raised the righteous army.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Liu Zhenghui, marshal of Kaiyang Prefecture, to accuse Wei and the others of treason, beheaded them as a warning, and raised the righteous army.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣劉文靜使於突厥始畢可汗，令率兵相應。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he sent Liu Wenjing as envoy to the Göktürk Shibi Qaghan, asking him to lead troops in support.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he dispatched Liu Wenjing as envoy to the Göktürk Shibi Qaghan to request allied troops.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，命太宗將兵徇西河，下之。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the sixth month he ordered Taizong to lead troops against Xihe and take it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the sixth month he ordered Taizong to lead troops west against Xihe and capture it.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，建大將軍府，並置三軍，分為左右：以世子建成為隴西公、左領大都督，左統軍隸焉；

translations.literal: On guisi he established the Grand General's Headquarters and set three armies, divided into left and right: the heir Jiancheng was made Duke of Longxi, Left Commander-in-Chief, with the left army under him;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he established the Grand General's Headquarters with three armies, left and right: the heir Jiancheng became Duke of Longxi, Left Commander-in-Chief, commanding the left army;

sentences.zh: 太宗為燉煌公、右領大都督，右統軍隸焉。

translations.literal: Taizong was made Duke of Dunhuang, Right Commander-in-Chief, with the right army under him.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong became Duke of Dunhuang, Right Commander-in-Chief, commanding the right army.

sentences.zh: 裴寂為大將軍府長史，劉文靜為司馬，石艾縣長殷開山為掾，劉政會為屬，長孫順德、劉弘基、竇琮等分為左右統軍。

translations.literal: Pei Ji was Chief Clerk of the Grand General's Headquarters, Liu Wenjing Marshal, Yin Kaishan of Shiai County a staff officer, Liu Zhenghui an aide, and Sun Shunde, Liu Hongji, Dou Cong, and others were made left and right army commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Ji served as chief clerk, Liu Wenjing as marshal, Yin Kaishan of Shiai as staff officer, Liu Zhenghui as aide, and Sun Shunde, Liu Hongji, Dou Cong, and others as left and right army commanders.

sentences.zh: 開倉庫以賑窮乏，遠近響應。

translations.literal: They opened the granaries to relieve the destitute; from near and far men answered the call.
translations.idiomatic: They opened the granaries to relieve the poor, and men rallied from far and near.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，高祖率兵西圖關中，以元吉為鎮北將軍、太原留守。

translations.literal: On renzi of the seventh month, autumn, Gaozu led troops west to strike for Guanzhong, appointing Yuanji Garrison General of the North and Taiyuan garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the seventh month of autumn, Gaozu marched west toward Guanzhong, appointing Yuanji Garrison General of the North and left him to hold Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，發自太原，有兵三萬。

translations.literal: On guichou he set out from Taiyuan with thirty thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he departed Taiyuan with an army of thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，師次靈石縣，營於賈胡堡。

translations.literal: On bingchen the army stopped at Lingshi County and made camp at Jiahu Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the army halted at Lingshi County and encamped at Jiahu Fort.

sentences.zh: 隋武牙郎將宋老生屯霍邑以拒義師。

translations.literal: The Sui martial guard officer Song Laosheng garrisoned Huoyi to resist the righteous army.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui martial guard officer Song Laosheng held Huoyi to block the righteous army.

sentences.zh: 會霖雨積旬，饋運不給，高祖命旋師，太宗切諫乃止。

translations.literal: Rain fell in torrents for more than ten days; supplies could not be brought up; Gaozu ordered withdrawal, but Taizong urgently remonstrated and he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell for more than ten days; supply lines failed. Gaozu ordered a retreat, but Taizong urgently remonstrated and he held his course.

sentences.zh: 有白衣老父詣軍門曰：「余為霍山神使謁唐皇帝曰：『八月雨止，路出霍邑東南，吾當濟師。

translations.literal: An old man in white clothes came to the camp gate and said, "I am the envoy of Mount Huo come to address the Tang Emperor: 'When the rains cease in the eighth month, the road will emerge southeast of Huoyi—I shall aid your army.
translations.idiomatic: An old man in white came to the camp gate and said, "I am envoy of Mount Huo, sent to tell the Tang Emperor: 'When the rains end in the eighth month, the road will open southeast of Huoyi—I shall aid your army.

sentences.zh: 』高祖曰：「此神不欺趙無恤，豈負我哉！

translations.literal: '" Gaozu said, "This spirit did not deceive Zhao Wuxu—how would it betray me!
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu said, "This spirit did not deceive Zhao Wuxu—surely it will not fail me!"

sentences.zh: 」八月辛巳，高祖引師趨霍邑，斬宋老生，平霍邑。

translations.literal: " On xinsi of the eighth month Gaozu led the army toward Huoyi, beheaded Song Laosheng, and pacified Huoyi.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinsi of the eighth month Gaozu advanced on Huoyi, beheaded Song Laosheng, and pacified the city.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，進下臨汾郡及絳郡。

translations.literal: On bingxu he advanced and took Linfen and Jiang commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he advanced and captured Linfen and Jiang commanderies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，至龍門，突厥始畢可汗遣康稍利率兵五百人、馬二千匹，與劉文靜會於麾下。

translations.literal: On guisi he reached Longmen; the Göktürk Shibi Qaghan sent Kang Shaoli with five hundred troops and two thousand horses to join Liu Wenjing under his banner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he reached Longmen. The Göktürk Shibi Qaghan sent Kang Shaoli with five hundred men and two thousand horses to join Liu Wenjing.

sentences.zh: 隋驍衛大將軍屈突通鎮河東，津梁斷絕，關中向義者頗以為阻。

translations.literal: The Sui Valiant Cavalry Grand General Qu Tu Tong held Hedong; the ford was cut off, and those in Guanzhong who wished to join the cause were much hindered.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui Valiant Cavalry Grand General Qu Tu Tong held Hedong; the crossing was blocked, and sympathizers in Guanzhong were greatly hindered.

sentences.zh: 河東水濱居人，競進舟楫，不謀而至，前後數百人。

translations.literal: People dwelling along the banks of the Hedong River vied to bring boats; without planning they came, several hundred in all before and after.
translations.idiomatic: People along the Hedong River vied to offer boats; hundreds came unbidden, one after another.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，馮翊賊帥孫華、土門賊帥白玄度各率其眾送款，並具舟楫以待義師。

translations.literal: On renyin of the ninth month, Sun Hua, bandit chief of Fengyi, and Bai Xuandu, bandit chief of Tumen, each led their followers to submit, fully providing boats to await the righteous army.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the ninth month, Sun Hua of Fengyi and Bai Xuandu of Tumen each led their bands to submit, providing boats for the righteous army.

sentences.zh: 高祖令華與統軍王長諧、劉弘基引兵渡河。

translations.literal: Gaozu ordered Hua, with the army commanders Wang Changqi and Liu Hongji, to lead troops across the river.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu ordered Hua, with army commanders Wang Changqi and Liu Hongji, to lead troops across the river.

sentences.zh: 屈突通遣其武牙郎將桑顯和率眾數千，夜襲長諧，義師不利。

translations.literal: Qu Tu Tong sent his martial guard officer Sang Xianhe with several thousand men to raid Changqi by night; the righteous army fared ill.
translations.idiomatic: Qu Tu Tong sent his martial guard officer Sang Xianhe with several thousand men to raid Changqi by night; the righteous army suffered a setback.

sentences.zh: 太宗以游騎數百掩其後，顯和潰散，義軍復振。

translations.literal: Taizong with several hundred light horsemen struck their rear; Xianhe broke and scattered, and the righteous army rallied.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong struck their rear with several hundred light horsemen; Xianhe broke and fled, and the army rallied.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，馮翊太守蕭造以郡來降。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Administrator of Fengyi, Xiao Zao, surrendered the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Xiao Zao, Administrator of Fengyi, surrendered the commandery.

sentences.zh: 戊午，高祖親率眾圍河東，屈突通自守不出，乃命攻城，不利而還。

translations.literal: On wuwu Gaozu personally led the host to besiege Hedong; Qu Tu Tong held firm and would not come out, so he ordered an assault on the city, which failed and he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Gaozu personally besieged Hedong. Qu Tu Tong held the city and would not emerge; an assault failed and Gaozu withdrew.

sentences.zh: 文武將吏請高祖領太尉，加置僚佐，從之。

translations.literal: Civil and military officers and generals asked Gaozu to assume the post of Grand Commandant and add staff; he consented.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officers asked Gaozu to assume the post of Grand Commandant with a full staff; he agreed.

sentences.zh: 華陰令李孝常以永豐倉來降。

translations.literal: Li Xiaochang, the magistrate of Huayin, came over with Yongfeng Granary.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiaochang, magistrate of Huayin, surrendered Yongfeng Granary.

sentences.zh: 庚申，高祖率軍濟河，舍於長春宮。

translations.literal: On gengshen Gaozu led the army across the river and lodged at Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Gaozu crossed the river with his army and encamped at Changchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 三秦士庶至者日以千數，高祖禮之，咸過所望，人皆喜悅。

translations.literal: Gentry and commoners of the Three Qin came by the thousands each day; Gaozu treated them with courtesy exceeding their hopes, and all were glad.
translations.idiomatic: Gentry and commoners of the Three Qin arrived by the thousands daily; Gaozu received them with courtesy beyond their hopes, and all rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣隴西公建成、司馬劉文靜屯兵永豐倉，兼守潼關，以備他盜。

translations.literal: On bingyin he sent the Duke of Longxi Jiancheng and Marshal Liu Wenjing to encamp at Yongfeng Granary and also hold Tong Pass against other bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he sent Duke of Longxi Jiancheng and Marshal Liu Wenjing to hold Yongfeng Granary and guard Tong Pass against other raiders.

sentences.zh: 太宗率劉弘基、長孫順德等前後數萬人，自渭北徇三輔，所至皆下。

translations.literal: Taizong led Liu Hongji, Sun Shunde, and others—several tens of thousands in all—from north of the Wei to sweep the Three Metropolises; wherever they went, all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong led Liu Hongji, Sun Shunde, and others—tens of thousands in all—from north of the Wei to sweep the Three Metropolises; every place they reached submitted.

sentences.zh: 高祖從父弟神通起兵鄠縣，柴氏婦舉兵於司竹，至是並與太宗會。

translations.literal: Gaozu's paternal cousin Shitong raised troops in E County; the Lady Chai raised troops at Sizhu; now both joined Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu's paternal cousin Shitong had raised troops in E County, and Lady Chai at Sizhu; now both joined Taizong.

sentences.zh: 郿縣賊帥丘師利、李仲文，盩厔賊帥何潘仁等，合眾數萬來降。

translations.literal: Qiu Shili of Mei County, Li Zhongwen, He Panren of Zhouzhi, and others combined several tens of thousands and came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chiefs Qiu Shili and Li Zhongwen of Mei, and He Panren of Zhouzhi, brought several tens of thousands to surrender.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命太宗自渭汭屯兵阿城，隴西公建成自新豐趣霸上。

translations.literal: On yihai he ordered Taizong to encamp at Acheng from the bend of the Wei, and the Duke of Longxi Jiancheng to advance from Xinfeng toward Bashang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he ordered Taizong to encamp at Acheng from the Wei bend, and Duke of Longxi Jiancheng to advance from Xinfeng toward Bashang.

sentences.zh: 高祖率大軍自下邽西上，經煬帝行宮園苑，悉罷之，宮女放還親屬。

translations.literal: Gaozu led the great army west from Xiaji, passing the touring palaces and parks of Yangdi; he abolished them all and sent the palace women back to their kin.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu led the main army west from Xiaji, passing Yangdi's touring palaces and parks; he abolished them and sent the palace women home to their families.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，至長樂宮，有眾二十萬。

translations.literal: On xinsi in the tenth month, winter, he reached Changle Palace with two hundred thousand followers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the tenth month of winter he reached Changle Palace with two hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 京師留守刑部尚書衛文昇、右翊衛將軍陰世師、京兆郡丞滑儀挾代王侑以拒義師。

translations.literal: Wei Wensheng, Minister of Punishments and capital garrison commander, Yin Shishi, General of the Right Yiji Guard, and Hua Yi, Assistant Prefect of Jingzhao, held Prince Dai You to resist the righteous army.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Wensheng, Minister of Punishments and capital garrison commander, Yin Shishi of the Right Yiji Guard, and Hua Yi, Assistant Prefect of Jingzhao, held Prince Dai You and resisted the righteous army.

sentences.zh: 高祖遣使至城下，諭以匡復之意，再三皆不報。

translations.literal: Gaozu sent envoys below the walls to announce his intent to restore the realm; again and again there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu sent envoys to the walls to proclaim his intent to restore the dynasty; again and again they received no answer.

sentences.zh: 諸將固請圍城。

translations.literal: The generals firmly asked to besiege the city.
translations.idiomatic: The generals urgently pressed to besiege the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，攻拔京城。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the eleventh month they attacked and seized the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the eleventh month they stormed and took the capital.

sentences.zh: 衛文昇先已病死，以陰世師、滑儀等拒義兵，並斬之。

translations.literal: Wei Wensheng had already died of illness; for resisting the righteous army Yin Shishi, Hua Yi, and the others were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Wensheng had already died of illness; Yin Shishi, Hua Yi, and others who had resisted the righteous army were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，率百僚，備法駕，立代王侑為天子，遙尊煬帝為太上皇，大赦，改元為義寧。

translations.literal: On guihai he led the hundred officials, fully equipped with imperial regalia, to install Prince Dai You as Son of Heaven, honoring Yangdi from afar as Retired Emperor, granting a general amnesty, and changing the era name to Yining.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he led the officials in full imperial regalia to install Prince Dai You as emperor, honoring Yangdi from afar as Retired Emperor, proclaiming a general amnesty, and changing the era name to Yining.

sentences.zh: 甲子，隋帝詔加高祖假黃鉞、使持節、大都督內外諸軍事、大丞相，進封唐王，總錄萬機。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Sui emperor issued an edict granting Gaozu the provisional yellow axe, credentials as envoy holding the staff of authority, Grand Commandant over all military affairs within and without, and enfeoffing him as Prince of Tang with charge of all affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Sui emperor issued an edict granting Gaozu the provisional yellow axe, credentials as commissioner holding the staff of authority, and Grand Commandant over all military affairs, enfeoffing him as Prince of Tang with charge of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 以武德殿為丞相府，改教為令。

translations.literal: The Wude Hall became the prince's chancellery; edicts were changed to orders.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Hall became the princely chancellery; edicts were restyled as orders.

sentences.zh: 以隴西公建成為唐國世子；

translations.literal: The Duke of Longxi Jiancheng was made Heir of Tang;
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Longxi Jiancheng was made Heir of Tang;

sentences.zh: 太宗為京兆尹，改封秦公；

translations.literal: Taizong was made Metropolitan Governor of Jingzhao and his fief was changed to Duke of Qin;
translations.idiomatic: Taizong was made Metropolitan Governor of Jingzhao and enfeoffed as Duke of Qin;

sentences.zh: 姑臧公元吉為齊公。

translations.literal: Yuanji of Guzang was enfeoffed as Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji of Guzang was made Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，丞相府置長史、司錄已下官僚。

translations.literal: On guwei of the twelfth month the princely chancellery established officials from Chief Clerk and Registrar on down.
translations.idiomatic: On guwei of the twelfth month the princely chancellery established offices from chief clerk and registrar downward.

sentences.zh: 金城賊帥薛舉寇扶風，命太宗為元帥擊之。

translations.literal: Xue Ju, bandit chief of Jincheng, raided Fufeng; he ordered Taizong as supreme commander to strike him.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ju, bandit chief of Jincheng, raided Fufeng; Gaozu ordered Taizong as supreme commander to attack him.

sentences.zh: 遣趙郡公孝恭招慰山南，所至皆下。

translations.literal: He sent the Duke of Zhao Commandery Xiaogong to win over the south of the mountains; wherever he went, all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Duke of Zhao Commandery Xiaogong to win over the south of the mountains; every place submitted.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太宗大破薛舉之眾於扶風。

translations.literal: On guisi Taizong routed Xue Ju's forces at Fufeng in a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Taizong won a great victory over Xue Ju's army at Fufeng.

sentences.zh: 屈突通自潼關奔東都，劉文靜等追擒於閿鄉，虜其眾數萬。

translations.literal: Qu Tu Tong fled east from Tong Pass; Liu Wenjing and others pursued and captured him at Wenxiang, taking several tens of thousands captive.
translations.idiomatic: Qu Tu Tong fled east from Tong Pass; Liu Wenjing and others pursued and captured him at Wenxiang, taking tens of thousands prisoner.

sentences.zh: 河池太守蕭瑀以郡降。

translations.literal: Xiao Yu, Administrator of Hechi, submitted the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu, Administrator of Hechi, surrendered the commandery.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣雲陽令詹俊、武功縣正李仲袞徇巴蜀，下之。

translations.literal: On bingwu he sent Yunyang Magistrate Zhan Jun and Wugong District Director Li Zhonggun to sweep Ba and Shu and take them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he sent Yunyang Magistrate Zhan Jun and Wugong District Director Li Zhonggun to subdue Ba and Shu.

sentences.zh: 武德元年二年春正月戊辰，世子建成為撫寧大將軍、東討元帥，太宗為副，總兵七萬，徇地東都。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wude, in the spring of the first month, on the day wuchen, the heir Jiancheng was made Pacification Grand General and Eastern Campaign Commander-in-Chief, Taizong his deputy; together they commanded seventy thousand troops to sweep the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wude, in the spring of the first month, on the day wuchen, the heir Jiancheng was appointed Pacification Grand General and Eastern Campaign Commander-in-Chief, with Taizong as his deputy; together they led seventy thousand men against the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 二月，清河賊帥竇建德僭稱長樂王。

translations.literal: In the second month, Dou Jiande, bandit chief of Qinghe, presumptuously styled himself Prince of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Dou Jiande, bandit chief of Qinghe, presumptuously declared himself Prince of Changle.

sentences.zh: 吳興人沈法興據丹陽起兵。

translations.literal: A man of Wuxing, Shen Faxing, raised troops and occupied Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Faxing of Wuxing raised troops and seized Danyang.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，右屯衛將軍宇文化及弒隋太上皇於江都宮，立秦王浩為帝，自稱大丞相。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the third month, the Right Garrison General Yuwen Huaji killed the Sui Retired Emperor at Jiangdu Palace, set up Prince Hao of Qin as emperor, and called himself Grand Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the third month, Right Garrison General Yuwen Huaji assassinated the Sui Retired Emperor at Jiangdu Palace, installed Prince Hao of Qin as emperor, and styled himself Grand Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 徙封太宗為趙國公。

translations.literal: Taizong's fief was changed to Duke of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong's enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，隋帝進高祖相國，總百揆，備九錫之禮。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the Sui emperor advanced Gaozu to Chancellor, charged him with all government affairs, and equipped him with the rites of the Nine Bestowals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the Sui emperor promoted Gaozu to Chancellor, put all state affairs in his hands, and granted him the full rites of the Nine Bestowals.

sentences.zh: 唐國置丞相以下，立皇高祖已下四廟於長安通義里第。

translations.literal: The Tang state established offices from Chancellor downward, and set up four ancestral temples from Imperial Grandfather downward at the Tongyi Lane residence in Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang regime created offices from chancellor down and established four ancestral temples—from Imperial Grandfather on—at the family estate in Tongyi Lane, Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，停竹使符，頒銀菟符於諸郡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on xinmao, bamboo envoy tallies were discontinued and silver rabbit tallies were issued to the commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinmao, bamboo envoy tallies were abolished and silver rabbit tallies distributed to the commanderies.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，世子建成及太宗自東都班師。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Heir Jiancheng and Taizong returned victorious from the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the heir Jiancheng and Taizong led their armies back in triumph from the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，天子詔高祖冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕。

translations.literal: On yisi of the fifth month, the Son of Heaven decreed that Gaozu wear a twelve-tassel crown, raise the imperial banner, and have the route cleared on going out and coming in.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the fifth month the Son of Heaven decreed that Gaozu might wear a twelve-tassel crown, raise the imperial standard, and travel with full imperial escort.

sentences.zh: 王后、王女爵命之號，一遵舊典。

translations.literal: The titles for queen and princesses all followed the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Titles for the queen and imperial daughters followed the former regulations.

sentences.zh: 戊午，隋帝詔曰：

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Sui emperor issued an edict stating:
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Sui emperor promulgated an edict:

sentences.zh: 遣使持節、兼太保、邢部尚書、光祿大夫、梁郡公蕭造，兼太尉、司農少卿裴之隱奉皇帝璽綬於高祖。

translations.literal: He sent Commissioner Xiao Zao—concurrent Grand Tutor, Minister of Punishments, and Duke of Liang—and Commissioner Pei Zhiyin, Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries, to present the imperial seal and cord to Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched envoys holding the staff of authority: Xiao Zao, concurrent Grand Tutor and Minister of Punishments, Duke of Liang, and Pei Zhiyin of the Court of the Imperial Granaries, to deliver the imperial seal and cord to Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 高祖辭讓，百僚上表勸進，至於再三，乃從之。

translations.literal: Gaozu declined; the hundred officials submitted memorials urging him to accept, again and again; only on the third round did he consent.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu refused. The officials memorialized again and again urging him to take the throne; only after repeated pleas did he yield.

sentences.zh: 隋帝遜於舊邸。

translations.literal: The Sui emperor retired to the old residence.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui emperor withdrew to his former palace.

sentences.zh: 改大興殿為太極殿。

translations.literal: Daxing Hall was renamed Taiji Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Daxing Hall was renamed the Hall of Supreme Pole.

sentences.zh: 甲子，高祖即皇帝位於太極殿，命刑部尚書蕭造兼太尉，告於南郊，大赦天下，改隋義寧二年為唐武德元年。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Gaozu took the imperial throne in Taiji Hall, ordered Minister of Punishments Xiao Zao, concurrent Grand Commandant, to announce at the southern suburbs, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed Sui Yining year 2 to Tang Wude year 1.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Gaozu ascended the throne in Taiji Hall, had Xiao Zao announce the mandate at the southern altar, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era from Sui Yining 2 to Tang Wude 1.

sentences.zh: 官人百姓，賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Officials and commoners were each granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Every official and commoner was granted one step in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 義師所行之處，給復三年。

translations.literal: Where the righteous army had passed, remission was granted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Every district the righteous army had traversed received three years of tax relief.

sentences.zh: 罷郡置州，改太守為刺史。

translations.literal: Commanderies were abolished and prefectures established; grand administrators were renamed prefects.
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies were abolished in favor of prefectures, and grand administrators became prefects.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宴百官於太極殿，賜帛有差。

translations.literal: On dingmao he feasted the hundred officials in Taiji Hall and bestowed silk in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he held a feast for the court in Taiji Hall and distributed silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 東都留守官共立隋越王侗為帝。

translations.literal: The officials left to guard the eastern capital jointly installed Sui Prince Yue Tong as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The officials holding the eastern capital together enthroned the Sui Prince of Yue, Yang Tong.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命相國長史裴寂等修律令。

translations.literal: On renshen he ordered Grand Chancellor Chief Clerk Pei Ji and others to revise statutes and ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he charged Pei Ji, chief clerk of the grand chancellery, and others with revising the law code.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，太宗為尚書令，相國府長史裴寂為尚書右僕射，相國府司馬劉文靜為納言，隋民部尚書蕭瑀、相國府司錄竇威並為內史令。

translations.literal: On jiaxu of the sixth month, Taizong became Director of the Department of State Affairs; Grand Chancellor Chief Clerk Pei Ji became Right Vice Director; Grand Chancellor Marshal Liu Wenjing became Censor-in-Chief; Sui Minister of Revenue Xiao Yu and Grand Chancellor Registrar Dou Wei both became Directors of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the sixth month Taizong was made Director of the Department of State Affairs; Pei Ji became Right Vice Director; Liu Wenjing, Censor-in-Chief; and Xiao Yu and Dou Wei both Directors of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 廢隋《大業律令》，頒新格。

translations.literal: The Sui Daye statutes and ordinances were abolished and new administrative rules promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui Daye legal code was repealed and a new set of regulations issued.

sentences.zh: 己卯，備法駕，迎皇高祖宣簡公已下神主，祔於太廟。

translations.literal: On jimao, with full imperial equipage they welcomed the spirit tablets of Imperial Grandfather Xuanjian and below to be enshrined in the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, with full imperial ceremony, they brought the spirit tablets of Imperial Grandfather Xuanjian and his successors to the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 追謚妃竇氏為太穆皇后，陵曰壽安。

translations.literal: Consort Dou was posthumously honored as Grand Empress Zhaomu; her tomb was called Shou'an.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Dou was posthumously titled Grand Empress Zhaomu and buried at Shou'an.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，立世子建成為後太子。

translations.literal: On gengchen the heir Jiancheng was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Jiancheng was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 封太宗為秦王，齊國公元吉為齊王。

translations.literal: Taizong was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin; Prince of Qi Yuanji as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong was created Prince of Qin and Yuanji Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 封宗室蜀國公孝基為永安王，柱國公道玄為淮陽王，長平公叔良為長平王，鄭國公神通為永康王，安吉公神符為襄邑王，柱國德良為長樂王，上開府道素為竟陵王，上柱國博乂為隴西王，奉慈為渤海王。

translations.literal: Among the imperial clan, Duke of Shu Xiaoji was made Prince of Yong'an; Pillar Duke Daoxuan Prince of Huaiyang; Duke of Changping Shuliang Prince of Changping; Duke of Zheng Shitong Prince of Yongkang; Duke of Anji Shenfu Prince of Xiangyi; Pillar Duke Deliang Prince of Changle; Upper Opener Daosu Prince of Jingling; Upper Pillar Duke Boyi Prince of Longxi; Fengci Prince of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: The clan was enfeoffed: Xiaoji as Prince of Yong'an, Daoxuan as Prince of Huaiyang, Shuliang as Prince of Changping, Shitong as Prince of Yongkang, Shenfu as Prince of Xiangyi, Deliang as Prince of Changle, Daosu as Prince of Jingling, Boyi as Prince of Longxi, and Fengci as Prince of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 諸州總管加號使持節。

translations.literal: Military commissioners of the commanderies were given the additional title commissioner holding the staff.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural military commissioners were granted the added title of commissioner holding the staff of authority.

sentences.zh: 癸未，封隋帝為酅國公。

translations.literal: On guimao the Sui emperor was enfeoffed as Duke of Xi.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the former Sui emperor was created Duke of Xi.

sentences.zh: 薛舉寇涇州，命秦王為西討元帥征之。

translations.literal: Xue Ju raided Jingzhou; the Prince of Qin was ordered supreme commander of the western campaign to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ju raided Jing Prefecture; the Prince of Qin was appointed supreme commander of the western expedition against him.

sentences.zh: 改封永康王神通為淮安王。

translations.literal: Prince of Yongkang Shitong was changed to Prince of Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yongkang Shitong was retitled Prince of Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，加秦王雍州牧，餘官如故。

translations.literal: On renchen the Prince of Qin was additionally made Governor of Yongzhou; his other posts were unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Prince of Qin was also appointed Governor of Yongzhou, retaining his other offices.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，內史令竇威卒。

translations.literal: On xinchou Inner Affairs Director Dou Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Dou Wei, Director of the Palace Secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，刑部尚書蕭造為太子太保。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingwu, Minister of Punishments Xiao Zao became Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingwu, Xiao Zao was appointed Grand Tutor to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 追封皇子玄霸為衛王。

translations.literal: Prince Xuanba was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: The deceased Prince Xuanba was posthumously created Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 西突厥遣使內附。

translations.literal: The Western Göktürks sent envoys to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Turks sent envoys to swear allegiance.

sentences.zh: 秦王與薛舉大戰於涇州，我師敗績。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin fought a great battle with Xue Ju at Jingzhou; our army suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin met Xue Ju in a great battle at Jingzhou and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，薛舉死，其子仁杲復僭稱帝，命秦王為元帥以討之。

translations.literal: On renwu in the eighth month, Xue Ju died; his son Ren Gao again presumptuously declared himself emperor; the Prince of Qin was appointed supreme commander to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the eighth month Xue Ju died. His son Ren Gao again proclaimed himself emperor, and the Prince of Qin was named supreme commander to crush him.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「隋太常卿高熲、上柱國賀若弼，並抗節不阿，矯枉無撓；

translations.literal: On dinghai an edict stated: "Sui Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Gao Jiong and Upper Pillar Duke He Ruobi both held to their integrity and would not bow; they straightened what was crooked and would not be bent."
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict read: "Gao Jiong, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness under the Sui, and He Ruobi, Upper Pillar Duke, were men of unbending integrity who refused to yield and would not be turned aside."

sentences.zh: 司隸大夫薛道衡、刑部尚書宇文弼、左翊衛將軍董純，並懷忠抱義，以陷極刑：宜從褒飾，以慰泉壤。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the Capital Xue Daoheng, Minister of Punishments Yuwen Bi, and Left Yiji Guard General Dong Chun all cherished loyalty and embraced righteousness, yet suffered the extreme penalty: they should receive posthumous honors to comfort them in the grave.
translations.idiomatic: "Xue Daoheng, Supervisor of the Capital, Yuwen Bi, Minister of Punishments, and Dong Chun, general of the Left Yiji Guard, were loyal men who died unjustly—the court should honor them and ease their spirits below."

sentences.zh: 熲可贈上柱國、郯國公，弼贈上柱國、杞國公，各令有司加謚；

translations.literal: Jiong was posthumously granted Upper Pillar Duke and Duke of Tan; Bi was posthumously granted Upper Pillar Duke and Duke of Qi; each was to receive a posthumous title from the relevant office.
translations.idiomatic: Jiong was posthumously made Upper Pillar Duke and Duke of Tan; Bi Upper Pillar Duke and Duke of Qi; the proper offices were to assign their posthumous names.

sentences.zh: 道衡贈上開府、臨河縣公，贈上開府、平昌縣公，純贈柱國、狄道縣公。

translations.literal: Daoheng was granted Upper Opener and Duke of Linhe; Bi was granted Upper Opener and Duke of Pingchang; Chun was granted Pillar Duke and Duke of Didao."
translations.idiomatic: Daoheng was raised to Upper Opener and Duke of Linhe; Bi to Upper Opener and Duke of Pingchang; and Chun to Pillar Duke and Duke of Didao."

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「隋右驍衛大將軍李金才、左光祿大夫李敏，並鼎族高門，元功世胄，橫受屠殺，朝野稱冤。

translations.literal: " Another edict stated: "Sui Right Valiant Cavalry Grand General Li Jincai and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Min were both of eminent houses and hereditary merit, yet were slaughtered without cause; court and countryside alike called it injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict declared: "Li Jincai, Sui Right Valiant Cavalry Grand General, and Li Min, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, came from great clans and long service, yet were put to death—everyone knew the charge was false."

sentences.zh: 然李氏將興，天祚有應，冥契深隱，妄肆誅夷。

translations.literal: Yet the Li house was destined to rise; Heaven's favor had its response; a deep hidden pact was wantonly answered with massacre.
translations.idiomatic: "The Li were fated to rule; Heaven had already chosen them, yet obscure prophecies were used as pretext for a wholesale slaughter."

sentences.zh: 朕受命君臨，志存刷蕩，申冤旌善，無忘寤寐。

translations.literal: I have received the mandate and rule the realm; my will is set on sweeping away wrongs, declaring grievances and displaying goodness, and I do not forget this even in sleep.
translations.idiomatic: "Now that I hold the mandate, I mean to clear away these wrongs, vindicate the innocent, and reward the loyal—I have not ceased to think of it night or day."

sentences.zh: 金才可贈上柱國、申國公，敏可贈柱國、觀國公。

translations.literal: Jincai was posthumously granted Upper Pillar Duke and Duke of Shen; Min was posthumously granted Pillar Duke and Duke of Guan.
translations.idiomatic: Jincai was posthumously made Upper Pillar Duke and Duke of Shen; Min Pillar Duke and Duke of Guan.

sentences.zh: 又前代酷濫，子孫被流者，並放還鄉里。

translations.literal: " Moreover, descendants banished in former generations for excessive punishments were all released to return to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: "Descendants exiled under earlier reigns for harsh sentences were also pardoned and sent home."

sentences.zh: 」涼州賊帥李軌以其地來降，拜涼州總管，封涼王。

translations.literal: Li Gui, bandit chief of Liangzhou, submitted his territory in surrender; he was appointed Military Commissioner of Liangzhou and enfeoffed Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gui, rebel leader in Liangzhou, surrendered his domain and was appointed military commissioner of Liangzhou with the title Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，親錄囚徒，改銀菟符為銅魚符。

translations.literal: On yisi of the ninth month he personally reviewed prisoners; silver rabbit tallies were changed to bronze fish tallies.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the ninth month he reviewed prisoners in person and replaced silver rabbit tallies with bronze fish tallies.

sentences.zh: 辛未，追謚隋太上皇為煬帝。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Sui Retired Emperor was posthumously titled Emperor Yang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the retired Sui sovereign was given the posthumous name Emperor Yang.

sentences.zh: 宇文化及至魏州，鴆殺秦王浩，僭稱天子，國號許。

translations.literal: Yuwen Huaji reached Weizhou, poisoned Prince Hao of Qin, presumptuously declared himself emperor, and styled his state Xu.
translations.idiomatic: At Weizhou Yuwen Huaji poisoned Prince Hao of Qin, seized the title of emperor, and proclaimed the state of Xu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day renshi of the tenth month of winter, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth winter month there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 李密率眾來降。

translations.literal: Li Mi led his forces to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mi came over with his army.

sentences.zh: 封皇從父弟襄武公琛為襄武王，黃臺公瑗為廬江王。

translations.literal: Imperial cousin Duke of Xiangwu Chen was made Prince of Xiangwu; Duke of Huangtai Yuan was made Prince of Lujiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's cousin Chen was created Prince of Xiangwu and Yuan Prince of Lujiang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔行傅仁均所造《戊寅歷》。

translations.literal: On guisi an edict ordered the adoption of the Wuyin Calendar compiled by Fu Renjun.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the court decreed use of Fu Renjun's Wuyin Calendar.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，以京師穀貴，令四面入關者，車馬牛驢各給課米，充其自食。

translations.literal: On jiyou, because grain in the capital was dear, those entering the passes from all four sides were given tax-grain for their horses, oxen, and donkeys to feed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, with grain scarce in the capital, travelers entering the passes from every direction received rations of tax grain for their draft animals.

sentences.zh: 秦王大破薛仁杲於淺水原，降之，隴右平。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin won a great victory over Xue Ren Gao at Qianshui Plain, accepted his surrender, and the Longyou region was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin shattered Xue Ren Gao at Qianshui Plain, took his surrender, and pacified the west.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，涼王李軌僭稱天子於涼州。

translations.literal: On yisi Prince of Liang Li Gui presumptuously declared himself emperor at Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Li Gui, Prince of Liang, declared himself emperor at Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔頒五十三條格，以約法緩刑。

translations.literal: An edict promulgated fifty-three articles of administrative rules to simplify the law and ease punishments.
translations.idiomatic: The court issued fifty-three articles of administrative law to narrow the code and lighten penalties.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，加秦王太尉、陜東道大行臺。

translations.literal: On renshen in the twelfth month the Prince of Qin was additionally made Grand Commandant and chief of the Shandong Grand Office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the twelfth month the Prince of Qin was also made Grand Commandant and head of the Shandong circuit office.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封上柱國李孝常為義安王。

translations.literal: On dingchou Upper Pillar Duke Li Xiaochang was enfeoffed as Prince of Yi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Xiaochang was created Prince of Yi'an.

sentences.zh: 庚子，李密反於桃林，行軍總管盛彥師追討斬之。

translations.literal: On gengzi Li Mi rebelled at Taolin; Campaign General Sheng Yanshi pursued, attacked, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Mi rebelled at Taolin; Sheng Yanshi, campaign general, hunted him down and executed him.

sentences.zh: 武德二年二年春正月乙卯，初令文官遭父母喪者聽去職。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wude, in the spring of the first month, on yimao, for the first time civil officials mourning parents were permitted to leave office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wude, on yimao of the first spring month, civil officials were for the first time allowed to resign and observe mourning for their parents.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎陳叔達兼納言。

translations.literal: Yellow Gate Vice Director Chen Shuda was made concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shuda, Vice Director of the Yellow Gate, was also appointed Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，詔天下諸宗人無職任者，不在徭役之限，每州置宗師一人，以相統攝。

translations.literal: On bingxu an edict stated that clansmen throughout the realm without office were exempt from corvée labor, and each prefecture was to appoint one clan director to oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict freed unemployed clansmen empire-wide from corvée and ordered each prefecture to name a clan director to supervise them.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，竇建德攻宇文化及於聊城，斬之，傳首突厥。

translations.literal: On dingyou Dou Jiande attacked Yuwen Huaji at Liaocheng, beheaded him, and sent his head to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Dou Jiande besieged Yuwen Huaji at Liaocheng, killed him, and forwarded his head to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛丑，劉武周侵我并州。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on xinchou, Liu Wuzhou invaded our Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinchou, Liu Wuzhou raided Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，李密舊將徐世勣以黎陽之眾及河南十郡降，授黎州總管，封曹國公，賜姓李氏。

translations.literal: On jiyou Xu Shiji, former general of Li Mi, surrendered with the forces of Liyang and ten commanderies of Henan; he was appointed Military Commissioner of Li Prefecture, enfeoffed Duke of Cao, and granted the surname Li.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Xu Shiji, once Li Mi's lieutenant, surrendered with the army at Liyang and ten Henan commanderies; he was made military commissioner of Li, created Duke of Cao, and given the imperial surname Li.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上微行都邑，以察氓俗，即日還宮。

translations.literal: On gengxu the sovereign made a private tour of the capital to observe the people's customs, and that same day returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Emperor went about the capital incognito to see how the people lived, then returned to the palace the same day.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賊帥硃粲殺我使散騎常侍段確，奔洛陽。

translations.literal: On jiayin the bandit chief Zhu Can killed our envoy Regular Attendant Duan Que and fled to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the rebel Zhu Can murdered the envoy Duan Que and fled to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，王世充篡越王侗位，僭稱天子，國號鄭。

translations.literal: On yisi of the fourth month, Wang Shichong usurped Prince Yue Tong's throne, presumptuously declared himself emperor, and styled his state Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the fourth month Wang Shichong deposed Yang Tong and declared himself emperor of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，李軌為其偽尚書安興貴所執以降，河右平。

translations.literal: On xinhai Li Gui was seized and surrendered by his false Minister of State An Xinggui; the region west of the Yellow River was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Gui was betrayed and captured by his minister An Xinggui; the northwest submitted.

sentences.zh: 突厥始畢可汗死。

translations.literal: The Göktürk Qaghan Shibi died.
translations.idiomatic: Shibi Qaghan of the Turks died.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，酅國公薨，追崇為隋帝，謚曰恭。

translations.literal: On jimao the Duke of Xi died; he was posthumously honored as Sui emperor with the posthumous name Gong.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Duke of Xi died and was posthumously honored as Emperor Gong of Sui.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，令國子學立周公、孔子廟，四時致祭，仍博求其後。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict ordered the Directorate of Education to establish temples to the Duke of Zhou and Confucius, with seasonal sacrifices, and broadly to seek their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the court ordered the imperial academy to build temples to the Duke of Zhou and Confucius with seasonal rites, and to search out their descendants.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，尚書右僕射裴寂為晉州道行軍總管，以討劉武周。

translations.literal: On guihai Right Vice Director Pei Ji became campaign commander of the Jinzhou circuit to attack Liu Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Pei Ji was appointed commander of the Jinzhou expedition against Liu Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，置十二軍，以關內諸府分隸焉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen, twelve armies were established, and the prefectures within the passes were assigned to them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen, twelve armies were formed and the Guanzhong prefectures were divided among them.

sentences.zh: 王世充遣其將羅士信侵我穀州，士信率其眾來降。

translations.literal: Wang Shichong sent his general Luo Shixin to raid our Gu Prefecture; Shixin led his troops to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shichong sent Luo Shixin against Gu Prefecture, but Shixin defected with his men.

sentences.zh: 西突厥葉護可汗及高昌並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The Western Turk Qaghan Yabghu and Gaochang both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Turk qaghan and the king of Gaochang both sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，賊帥李子通據江都，僭稱天子，國號吳。

translations.literal: On xinwei the bandit chief Li Zitong held Jiangdu, presumptuously declared himself emperor, and styled his state Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Zitong seized Jiangdu, proclaimed himself emperor, and named his state Wu.

sentences.zh: 沈法興據毗陵，僭稱梁王。

translations.literal: Shen Faxing held Piling and presumptuously styled himself Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Faxing occupied Piling and declared himself Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，和州賊帥杜伏威遣使來降，授和州總管、東南道行臺尚書令，封楚王。

translations.literal: On dingchou Du Fuwei, bandit chief of He Province, sent envoys to surrender; he was appointed Military Commissioner of He, Chief of the Southeast Circuit Office, and enfeoffed Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Du Fuwei of Hezhou submitted; he was made military commissioner of He, head of the southeast circuit, and Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 裴寂與劉武周將宋金剛戰於介州，我師敗績，右武衛大將軍姜寶誼死之。

translations.literal: Pei Ji fought Liu Wuzhou's general Song Jingang at Jie Prefecture; our army suffered defeat, and Right Martial Guard Grand General Jiang Baoyi died.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Ji met Song Jingang, Liu Wuzhou's general, at Jiezhou and was beaten; Jiang Baoyi, grand general of the Right Martial Guard, was killed.

sentences.zh: 并州總管、齊王元吉懼武周所逼，奔於京師，并州陷。

translations.literal: Bingzhou Military Commissioner, Prince of Qi Yuanji, fearing Liu Wuzhou's pressure, fled to the capital; Bingzhou fell.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Yuanji, military commissioner of Bingzhou, fled to Chang'an before Liu Wuzhou's advance, and Bingzhou was lost.

sentences.zh: 乙未，京師地震。

translations.literal: On yiwei the capital region was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jihai.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, day jihai.

sentences.zh: 封幽州總管羅藝為燕郡王，賜姓李氏。

translations.literal: Military Commissioner of Youzhou Luo Yi was enfeoffed Prince of Yan Commandery and granted the surname Li.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Yi, military commissioner of Youzhou, was created Prince of Yan and given the surname Li.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎楊恭仁為納言。

translations.literal: Yellow Gate Vice Director Yang Gongren was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Gongren, Vice Director of the Yellow Gate, was appointed Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 殺民部尚書、魯國公劉文靜。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue, Duke of Lu Liu Wenjing was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wenjing, Minister of Revenue and Duke of Lu, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，討劉武周，軍於蒲州，為諸軍聲援。

translations.literal: On yimao, to attack Liu Wuzhou, the army encamped at Puzhou as rear support for the other forces.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Emperor marched against Liu Wuzhou and encamped at Puzhou to support the front-line armies.

sentences.zh: 壬子，劉武周進圍晉州。

translations.literal: On renzi Liu Wuzhou advanced and besieged Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Liu Wuzhou pressed the siege of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上親祠華嶽。

translations.literal: On jiazi the sovereign personally sacrificed to Mount Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Emperor worshipped at Mount Hua in person.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，竇建德陷黎陽，盡有山東之地。

translations.literal: On bingzi Dou Jiande took Liyang and held all the lands east of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Dou Jiande captured Liyang and seized the entire Shandong region.

sentences.zh: 淮安王神通、左武候大將軍李世勣皆沒於賊。

translations.literal: Prince of Huai'an Shitong and Left Martial Guard Grand General Li Shiji were both captured by the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Huai'an Shitong and Li Shiji, grand general of the Left Martial Guard, both fell into rebel hands.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，永安王孝基、工部尚書獨孤懷恩、總管於筠為劉武周將宋金剛掩襲，並沒焉。

translations.literal: On bingshen Prince of Yong'an Xiaoji, Minister of Works Dugu Huai'en, and Supervisor Yu Yun were ambushed by Liu Wuzhou's general Song Jingang and all were lost.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Xiaoji, Prince of Yong'an, Works Minister Dugu Huai'en, and Supervisor Yu Yun were ambushed by Song Jingang and captured or killed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，狩於華山。

translations.literal: On jiachen he hunted on Mount Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he held a hunt on Mount Hua.

sentences.zh: 壬子，大風拔木。

translations.literal: On renzi a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi a violent gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 武德三年三年春正月辛巳，幸蒲州，命祀舜廟。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wude, in the spring of the first month, on xinsi, he visited Puzhou and ordered sacrifice at the temple of Shun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Wude, on xinsi of the first spring month, he went to Puzhou and commanded offerings at the temple of Emperor Shun.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，至自蒲州。

translations.literal: On guisi he returned from Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he came back from Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，李世勣於竇建德所自拔歸國。

translations.literal: On jiawu Li Shiji freed himself from Dou Jiande's custody and returned to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Shiji escaped from Dou Jiande and made his way back to Tang territory.

sentences.zh: 建德僭稱夏王。

translations.literal: Jiande presumptuously styled himself Prince of Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Jiande proclaimed himself Prince of Xia.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，京師西南地有聲如山崩。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the second month, southwest of the capital the ground sounded like a mountain collapsing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the second month a rumble like a landslide was heard southwest of the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸華陰。

translations.literal: On gengzi he traveled to Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Emperor went to Huayin.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書獨孤懷恩謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Works Minister Dugu Huai'en plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Dugu Huai'en, Minister of Works, plotted rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，西突厥葉護可汗、高昌王曲伯雅遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guiyou, Western Turk Qaghan Yabghu and King of Gaochang Qu Boya sent envoys to present tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou, the Western Turk qaghan Yabghu and Qu Boya, king of Gaochang, sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 突厥貢條支巨鳥。

translations.literal: The Turks presented tribute of a great bird from Tiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks presented a great bird from the western land of Tiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，改納言為侍中，內史令為中書令，給事郎為給事中。

translations.literal: On jimao, Nayan was changed to Palace Attendant, Inner Scribe Director to Director of the Palace Secretariat, and Gentlemen of the Secretariat to Masters of Writing Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the titles Nayan, Inner Scribe Director, and Gentlemen of the Secretariat were renamed Palace Attendant, Director of the Palace Secretariat, and Attendants of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，內史侍郎封德彞兼中書令。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Inner Scribe Vice Director Feng Deyi was made concurrent Director of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Feng Deyi, Vice Director of the Inner Scribe, was also appointed Director of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 封賊帥劉孝真為彭城王，賜姓李氏。

translations.literal: The bandit chief Liu Xiaozhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Pengcheng and granted the surname Li.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiaozhen, a rebel leader, was created Prince of Pengcheng and given the imperial surname Li.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，至自華陰。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin, he returned from Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renyin, he returned from Huayin.

sentences.zh: 於益州置行臺尚書省。

translations.literal: A mobile branch of the Department of State Affairs was established at Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: A regional headquarters of the Department of State Affairs was established in Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，加秦王益州道行臺尚書令。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the Prince of Qin was additionally made Director of the Yi Province Circuit Mobile Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Prince of Qin was also appointed head of the Yi Province circuit headquarters.

sentences.zh: 秦王大破宋金剛於介州，金剛與劉武周俱奔突厥，遂平并州。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin won a great victory over Song Jingang at Jie Prefecture; Jingang and Liu Wuzhou both fled to the Turks, and Bingzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin routed Song Jingang at Jiezhou; Jingang and Liu Wuzhou fled to the Turks, and Bingzhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 偽總管尉遲敬德、尋相以介州降。

translations.literal: The false military commissioners Yuchi Jingde and Xun Xiang surrendered Jie Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel commissioners Yuchi Jingde and Xun Xiang surrendered Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，徙封楚王杜伏威為吳王，賜姓李氏，加授東南道行臺尚書令。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renchen, Prince of Chu Du Fuwei was moved to Prince of Wu, granted the surname Li, and additionally appointed Director of the Southeast Circuit Mobile Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen, Du Fuwei was retitled Prince of Wu, given the surname Li, and made head of the southeast circuit headquarters.

sentences.zh: 丙午，親錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On bingwu he personally reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he reviewed prisoners in person.

sentences.zh: 封皇子元景為趙王，元昌為魯王，元亨為酆王；

translations.literal: Prince Yuanjing was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao, Yuanchang as Prince of Lu, Yuanheng as Prince of Feng;
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjing was created Prince of Zhao, Yuanchang Prince of Lu, and Yuanheng Prince of Feng;

sentences.zh: 皇孫承宗為太原王，承道為安陸王，承乾為恆山王，恪為長沙王，泰為宜都王。

translations.literal: Imperial grandsons Chengzong as Prince of Taiyuan, Chengdao as Prince of Anlu, Chengqian as Prince of Hengshan, Ke as Prince of Changsha, Tai as Prince of Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: and the Emperor's grandsons Chengzong, Chengdao, Chengqian, Ke, and Tai were created princes of Taiyuan, Anlu, Hengshan, Changsha, and Yidu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，命秦王率諸軍討王世充。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renxu, he ordered the Prince of Qin to lead the armies to attack Wang Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renxu, he ordered the Prince of Qin to lead the armies against Wang Shichong.

sentences.zh: 遣皇太子鎮蒲州，以備突厥。

translations.literal: The crown prince was sent to garrison Pu Prefecture to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince was posted at Puzhou to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 丙申，突厥殺劉武周於白道。

translations.literal: On bingshen the Turks killed Liu Wuzhou at Baidao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Turks killed Liu Wuzhou on the Baidao road.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，懷戍賊帥高開道遣使降，授蔚州總管，封北平郡王，賜姓李氏。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengzi, Huairou bandit chief Gao Kaidao sent envoys to surrender; he was appointed Military Commissioner of Yu Prefecture, enfeoffed Prince of Yanping Commandery, and granted the surname Li.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on gengzi, Gao Kaidao of Huairou submitted; he was made military commissioner of Youzhou, created Prince of Yanping, and given the surname Li.

sentences.zh: 武德四年四年春正月丁卯，竇建德行臺尚書令胡大恩以大安鎮來降，封定襄郡王，賜姓李氏。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude, in the spring of the first month, on dingmao, Dou Jiande's mobile director Hu Da'en surrendered Da'an post, was enfeoffed Prince of Dingxiang Commandery, and granted the surname Li.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Wude, on dingmao of the first spring month, Hu Da'en, director of Dou Jiande's field secretariat, surrendered Da'an garrison, was created Prince of Dingxiang, and given the surname Li.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命皇太子總統諸軍討稽胡。

translations.literal: On xinsi the crown prince was ordered to command all armies to attack the Ji Hu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the crown prince was appointed supreme commander against the Ji Hu.

sentences.zh: 三月，徙封宜都王泰為衛王。

translations.literal: In the third month, Prince of Yidu Tai was moved to Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Prince Tai of Yidu was retitled Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 竇建德來援王世充，攻陷我管州。

translations.literal: Dou Jiande came to relieve Wang Shichong and captured our Guan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Jiande marched to relieve Wang Shichong and seized Guanzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，封皇子元方為周王，元禮為鄭王，元嘉為宋王，元則為荊王，元茂為越王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, Prince Yuanfang was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhou, Yuanli as Prince of Zheng, Yuanjia as Prince of Song, Yuanze as Prince of Jing, Yuanmao as Prince of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiayin, Yuanfang was created Prince of Zhou, Yuanli of Zheng, Yuanjia of Song, Yuanze of Jing, and Yuanmao of Yue.

sentences.zh: 初置都護府官員。

translations.literal: For the first time officials of the Protectorate were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Protectorate office was staffed for the first time.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，秦王大破竇建德之眾於武牢，擒建德，河北悉平。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiwei, the Prince of Qin won a great victory over Dou Jiande's forces at Hulao, captured Jiande, and the Hebei region was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiwei, the Prince of Qin shattered Dou Jiande at Hulao, took him prisoner, and pacified Hebei.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，王世充舉東都降，河南平。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Wang Shichong surrendered the eastern capital, and Henan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wang Shichong surrendered Luoyang, and the Henan region submitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，秦王凱旋，獻俘於太廟。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiazi, the Prince of Qin returned in triumph and presented captives at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiazi, the Prince of Qin returned in triumph and offered prisoners at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On dingmao a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 廢五銖錢，行開元通寶錢。

translations.literal: The five-zhu coin was abolished and the Kaiyuan tongbao coin was put into circulation.
translations.idiomatic: The old five-zhu coinage was abolished and the Kaiyuan tongbao coin introduced.

sentences.zh: 斬竇建德於市；

translations.literal: Dou Jiande was beheaded in the market;
translations.idiomatic: Dou Jiande was beheaded in public;

sentences.zh: 流王世充於蜀，未發，為仇人所害。

translations.literal: Wang Shichong was banished to Shu; before he set out he was killed by an enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shichong was exiled to Shu but was killed by a foe before he could depart.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，建德餘黨劉黑闥據漳南反。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Jiande's remnant partisan Liu Heida seized the south of Zhang and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Liu Heida, a survivor of Jiande's cause, rose in the Zhangnan region.

sentences.zh: 置山東道行臺尚書省於洺州。

translations.literal: A Shandong Circuit mobile branch of the Department of State Affairs was established at Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Shandong circuit headquarters was established at Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，兗州總管徐圓朗舉兵反，以應劉黑闥，僭稱魯王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Yan Prefecture Military Commissioner Xu Yuanlang raised troops in rebellion to join Liu Heida and presumptuously styled himself Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Xu Yuanlang, military commissioner of Yanzhou, rebelled in support of Liu Heida and proclaimed himself Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，加秦王天策上將，位在王公上，領司徒、陜東道大行臺尚書令；

translations.literal: On jichou the Prince of Qin was additionally made Celestial-Strategy Supreme General, ranking above princes and dukes, holding the posts of Minister of Education and Director of the Shaanxi East Circuit Mobile Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Prince of Qin was made Celestial-Strategy Supreme General, senior to all princes and dukes, and retained the posts of Minister of Education and head of the Shaanxi east circuit;

sentences.zh: 齊王元吉為司空。

translations.literal: Prince of Qi Yuanji was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Yuanji was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，趙郡王孝恭平荊州，獲蕭銑。

translations.literal: On yisi, Prince of Zhao Commandery Xiaogong pacified Jing Prefecture and captured Xiao Xian.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Prince of Zhao Commandery Xiaogong pacified Jingzhou and captured Xiao Xian.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，於洺州置大行臺，廢洺州都督府。

translations.literal: On jiashen a great mobile office was established at Ming Prefecture and the Ming Prefecture military commissionerate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen a grand field headquarters was set up at Mingzhou and the local military commissionerate was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，焚東都紫微宮乾陽殿。

translations.literal: On gengyin the Qianyang Hall of the Ziwei Palace in the eastern capital was burned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Qianyang Hall of Luoyang's Ziwei Palace was burned down.

sentences.zh: 會稽賊帥李子通以其地來降。

translations.literal: Kuaiji bandit chief Li Zitong surrendered his territory.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zitong of Kuaiji submitted his territory.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，命秦王及齊王元吉討劉黑闥。

translations.literal: On dingmao he ordered the Prince of Qin and Prince of Qi Yuanji to attack Liu Heida.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he ordered the Prince of Qin and Prince of Qi Yuanji to campaign against Liu Heida.

sentences.zh: 壬申，徙封宋王元嘉為徐王。

translations.literal: On renshen Prince of Song Yuanjia was moved to Prince of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Prince Yuanjia of Song was retitled Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 武德五年五年春正月丙申，劉黑闥據洺州，僭稱漢東王。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wude, in the spring of the first month, on bingshen, Liu Heida seized Ming Prefecture and presumptuously styled himself Prince of Handong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Wude, on bingshen of the first spring month, Liu Heida seized Mingzhou and proclaimed himself Prince of Handong.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，秦王破劉黑闥於洺水上，盡復所陷州縣，黑闥亡奔突厥。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingwei, the Prince of Qin defeated Liu Heida on the Ming River, recovered all lost prefectures and counties, and Heida fled to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei, the Prince of Qin routed Liu Heida on the Ming River, recovered the lost districts, and Heida fled to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 蔚州總管、北平王高開道叛，寇易州。

translations.literal: Yu Prefecture Military Commissioner, Prince of Northern Peace Gao Kaidao rebelled and raided Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Kaidao, military commissioner of Youzhou and Prince of Northern Peace, rebelled and raided Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，秦王還京師，高祖迎勞於長樂宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu, the Prince of Qin returned to the capital; Gaozu went out to welcome and comfort him at Changle Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengxu, the Prince of Qin returned to Chang'an; Gaozu met him at Changle Palace with honors.

sentences.zh: 壬申，代州總管、定襄郡王大恩為虜所敗，戰死。

translations.literal: On renshen, Dai Prefecture Military Commissioner, Prince of Dingxiang Commandery Da'en was defeated by the barbarians and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Hu Da'en, military commissioner of Daizhou and Prince of Dingxiang, was defeated by the Turks and killed.

sentences.zh: 六月，劉黑闥引突厥寇山東。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Liu Heida led the Turks to raid Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Liu Heida brought Turk raiders into Shandong.

sentences.zh: 置諫議大夫官員。

translations.literal: Remonstrating and Consulting Grand Masters were established.
translations.idiomatic: The office of remonstrating and consulting grand master was created.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，吳王伏威來朝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on dinghai, Prince of Wu Fuwei came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dinghai, Prince of Wu Fuwei presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 隋漢陽太守馮盎以南越之地來降，嶺表悉定。

translations.literal: Sui Administrator of Hanyang Feng Ang surrendered the lands of southern Yue, and the Lingnan region was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ang, former Sui administrator of Hanyang, surrendered the far south, and Lingnan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，以洺、荊、並、幽、交五州為大總管府。

translations.literal: On xinhai Ming, Jing, Bing, You, and Jiao Prefectures were made great military commissionerates.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Ming, Jing, Bing, You, and Jiao were made grand military commissionerates.

sentences.zh: 改封恆山王承乾為中山王。

translations.literal: Prince of Hengshan Chengqian was moved to Prince of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chengqian of Hengshan was retitled Prince of Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 葬隋煬帝於揚州。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang of Sui was buried at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui Emperor Yang was buried at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，突厥頡利寇雁門。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Turk Qaghan Jieli raided Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the Turk qaghan Jieli raided Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 己未，進寇朔州。

translations.literal: On jiwei he advanced further and raided Shuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he pressed on and raided Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 遣皇太子及秦王討擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: The crown prince and the Prince of Qin were sent to attack and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince and the Prince of Qin were dispatched against him and won a great victory.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，遣齊王元吉擊劉黑闥於洺州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guiyou, Prince of Qi Yuanji was sent to attack Liu Heida at Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on guiyou, Prince of Qi Yuanji was sent against Liu Heida at Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 時山東州縣多為黑闥所守，所在殺長吏以應之。
