translations.literal: At that time many Shandong prefectures and counties were still held by Heida; everywhere the chief officials were killed to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Many Shandong districts still answered to Heida, and local magistrates were murdered wherever men rose for him.

sentences.zh: 行軍總管、淮陽王道玄與黑闥戰於下博，道玄敗沒。

translations.literal: Campaign commander, Prince of Huaiyang Daoxuan fought Liu Heida at Xiabo; Daoxuan was defeated and lost.
translations.idiomatic: Li Daoxuan, Prince of Huaiyang and campaign commander, met Liu Heida at Xiabo and was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，命皇太子率兵討劉黑闥。

translations.literal: On jiashen the crown prince was ordered to lead troops against Liu Heida.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the crown prince was appointed to command the campaign against Liu Heida.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸宜州，簡閱將士。

translations.literal: On bingshen he traveled to Yi Prefecture to review troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he went to Yizhou to review the army.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，校獵於華池。

translations.literal: On bingchen he held a hunt at Huachi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he hunted at Huachi.

sentences.zh: 庚申，至自宜州。

translations.literal: On gengshen he returned from Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he returned from Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 皇太子破劉黑闥於魏州，斬之，山東平。

translations.literal: The crown prince defeated Liu Heida at Wei Prefecture, beheaded him, and Shandong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince defeated Liu Heida at Weizhou, executed him, and pacified Shandong.

sentences.zh: 武德六年六年春正月，吳王杜伏威為太子太保。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Wude, in the spring of the first month, Prince of Wu Du Fuwei became Grand Preceptor to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Wude, in the first spring month, Prince of Wu Du Fuwei was made Grand Preceptor to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，校獵於驪山。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinhai, he held a hunt on Mount Li.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinhai, he hunted on Mount Li.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，幸昆明池，宴百官。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yiwei, he visited Kunming Pool and feasted the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiwei, he visited Kunming Pool and gave a feast for the court.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，舊宅改為通義宮，曲赦京城系囚，於是置酒高會，賜從官帛各有差。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiwei, the old residence was made Tongyi Palace; a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the capital; thereupon wine was set out in a great gathering and silk was bestowed on attending officials in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiwei, the family estate became Tongyi Palace; capital prisoners received a partial pardon; the court then held a great banquet and distributed silk by rank.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以尚書右僕射、魏國公裴寂為左僕射，中書令、宋國公蕭瑀為右僕射，侍中、觀國公楊恭仁為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Duke of Wei Pei Ji was made Left Vice Director; Director of the Palace Secretariat, Duke of Song Xiao Yu was made Right Vice Director; and Palace Attendant, Duke of Guan Yang Gongren was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Pei Ji, Duke of Wei and Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, became Left Vice Director; Xiao Yu, Duke of Song and Director of the Palace Secretariat, became Right Vice Director; and Yang Gongren, Duke of Guan and Palace Attendant, became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，突厥頡利寇朔州，遣皇太子及秦王屯并州以備之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, the Turk Qaghan Jieli raided Shuo Prefecture; the crown prince and the Prince of Qin were sent to garrison Bing Prefecture to guard against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Turk qaghan Jieli raided Shuozhou; the crown prince and the Prince of Qin were posted at Bingzhou on guard.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，東南道行臺僕射輔公祏據丹陽反，僭稱宋王，遣趙郡王孝恭及嶺南道大使、永康縣公李靖討之。

translations.literal: On renzi, Southeast Circuit Vice Director Fu Gongshi seized Danyang and rebelled, presumptuously styling himself Prince of Song; Prince of Zhao Commandery Xiaogong and Grand Ambassador of the Lingnan Circuit, Duke of Yongkang county Li Jing were sent to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Fu Gongshi, vice director of the southeast circuit, seized Danyang and proclaimed himself Prince of Song; Prince of Zhao Commandery Xiaogong and Li Jing, Duke of Yongkang and ambassador of the Lingnan circuit, were sent to crush him.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吐谷渾內附。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Tuyuhun submitted and came within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Tuyuhun submitted to Tang rule.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，突厥退，皇太子班師。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Turks withdrew and the crown prince led the army back.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Turks withdrew and the crown prince returned with the army.

sentences.zh: 改東都為洛州。

translations.literal: The eastern capital was changed to Luo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang was redesignated Luo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 高開道引突厥寇幽州。

translations.literal: Gao Kaidao led the Turks to raid You Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Kaidao brought Turk raiders against Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，幸華陰。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter he traveled to Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month he went to Huayin.

sentences.zh: 十一月，校獵於沙苑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he held a hunt in Shayuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he hunted in Shayuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，以奉義監為龍躍宮，武功宅為慶善宮。

translations.literal: On yisi the Fengyi Palace was made Longyue Palace and the Wugong residence was made Qingshan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Fengyi Palace became Longyue Palace and the Wugong estate became Qingshan Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，至自華陰。

translations.literal: On jiayin he came back from Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he returned to the capital from Huayin.

sentences.zh: 武德七年七年春正月己酉，封高麗王高武為遼東郡王，百濟王扶餘璋為帶方郡王，新羅王金真平為樂浪郡王。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Wude, in the spring of the first month, on jiyou, King Gao Wu of Goguryeo was enfeoffed Prince of Liaodong Commandery, King Buyeo Zhang of Baekje as Prince of Daifang Commandery, and King Kim Jeong-pyeong of Silla as Prince of Lelang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Wude, on jiyou of the first spring month, Gao Wu of Goguryeo was created Prince of Liaodong, Buyeo Zhang of Baekje Prince of Daifang, and Kim Jeong-pyeong of Silla Prince of Lelang.

sentences.zh: 二月，高開道為部將張金樹所殺，以其地降。

translations.literal: In the second month, Gao Kaidao was killed by his officer Zhang Jinshu, and his territory surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Gao Kaidao was killed by his officer Zhang Jinshu, who then submitted the territory.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸國子學，親臨釋奠。

translations.literal: On dingsi he visited the Directorate of Education and personally performed the libation sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he visited the imperial academy and performed the libation rite in person.

sentences.zh: 改大總管府為大都督府。

translations.literal: Great military commissionerates were changed to great protectorates.
translations.idiomatic: Grand military commissionerates were renamed grand protectorates.

sentences.zh: 吳王伏威薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Wu Fuwei passed away.
translations.idiomatic: Du Fuwei, Prince of Wu, died.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，廢尚書省六司侍郎，增吏部郎中秩正四品，掌選事。

translations.literal: On wuyin the six vice directors of the Masters of Writing were abolished; the rank of Director in the Ministry of Personnel was raised to the full fourth grade and charged with selection affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the six vice-directorships of the Masters of Writing were abolished; directors in the Ministry of Personnel were raised to the fourth rank and put in charge of appointments.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，趙郡王孝恭大破輔公祏，擒之，丹陽平。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Prince of Zhao Commandery Xiaogong won a great victory over Fu Gongshi, captured him, and Danyang was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Prince of Zhao Commandery Xiaogong shattered Fu Gongshi, took him alive, and pacified Danyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，大赦天下，頒行新律令。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm and the new statutes and ordinances were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengzi, the court proclaimed a general amnesty and issued the new law code.

sentences.zh: 以天下大定，詔遭父母喪者聽終制。

translations.literal: Because the realm was fully settled, an edict allowed those mourning parents to observe the full mourning period.
translations.idiomatic: With the empire at peace, an edict permitted officials in mourning for parents to serve out the full term.

sentences.zh: 五月，造仁智宮於宜州之宜君縣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Renzhi Palace was built at Yijun county in Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Renzhi Palace was built at Yijun in Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 李世勣討徐圓朗，平之。

translations.literal: Li Shiji attacked Xu Yuanlang and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiji campaigned against Xu Yuanlang and subdued him.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，幸仁智宮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinchou, he traveled to Renzhi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinchou, he went to Renzhi Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午，至自仁智宮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiawu, he returned from Renzhi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiawu, he returned from Renzhi Palace.

sentences.zh: 巂州地震山崩，江水咽流。

translations.literal: Xi Prefecture suffered an earthquake; mountains collapsed and the river waters were choked.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake struck Xizhou; mountains collapsed and the river was blocked.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，突厥寇并州，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: On wuchen the Turks raided Bing Prefecture and the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the Turks raided Bingzhou and Chang'an was placed under guard.

sentences.zh: 壬午，突厥退。

translations.literal: On rengwu the Turks withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On rengwu the Turk raiders retreated.

sentences.zh: 乙未，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: On yiwei the capital alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the capital stood down from alert.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，幸慶善宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingmao, he traveled to Qingshan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on dingmao, he went to Qingshan Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幸終南山，謁老子廟。

translations.literal: On guiyou he visited Mount Zhongnan and paid his respects at the temple of Laozi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he went to Mount Zhongnan and made offering at the temple of Laozi.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，校獵於高陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, he conducted a hunt at Gaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, he held a hunt at Gaoling.

sentences.zh: 庚午，至自慶善宮。

translations.literal: On gengwu he returned from Qing Shan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he came back from Qing Shan Palace.

sentences.zh: 武德八年八年春二月己巳，親錄囚徒，多所原宥。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Wude, in the spring of the second month, on jisi, he personally reviewed prisoners and pardoned many.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Wude, on jisi of the second spring month, he personally examined prisoners and granted many pardons.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，造太和宮於終南山。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, the Taihe Palace was built on Mount Zhongnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month work began on Taihe Palace in the Zhongnan range.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，幸太和宮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiazi, he visited Taihe Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiazi, he went to Taihe Palace.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇定州，命皇太子往幽州，秦王往并州，以備突厥。

translations.literal: The Turks raided Dingzhou; he ordered the crown prince to go to Youzhou and the Prince of Qin to Bingzhou to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: When the Turks struck Dingzhou, he sent the crown prince to Youzhou and the Prince of Qin to Bingzhou to meet the threat.

sentences.zh: 八月，并州道總管張公謹與突厥戰於太谷，王師敗績，中書令溫彥博沒於賊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Zhang Gongjin, overall commander of the Bingzhou circuit, fought the Turks at Taigu; the royal army was defeated, and Secretariat Director Wen Yanbo was taken by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhang Gongjin, commander on the Bingzhou front, met the Turks at Taigu and was routed; Secretariat Director Wen Yanbo fell into enemy hands.

sentences.zh: 九月，突厥退。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Turks withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: By the ninth month the Turks had pulled back.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，幸周氏陂校獵，因幸龍躍宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinsi, he visited the Zhou clan embankment for a hunt and then went on to Longyue Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the tenth winter month he hunted at the Zhou clan embankment, then continued to Longyue Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，幸宜州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinmao, he visited Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao, he went to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，講武於同官縣。

translations.literal: On gengzi he held a military review at Tongguan County.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he drilled the troops at Tongguan County.

sentences.zh: 改封蜀王元軌為吳王，漢王元慶為陳王。

translations.literal: Prince of Shu Yuan Gui was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Wu, and Prince of Han Yuan Qing as Prince of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Shu Yuan Gui was made Prince of Wu, and Prince of Han Yuan Qing was made Prince of Chen.

sentences.zh: 加授秦王中書令，齊王元吉侍中。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qin was additionally appointed Secretariat Director; Prince of Qi Yuan Ji was made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin was given the additional post of Secretariat Director; Prince of Qi Yuan Ji was made Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 天策上將府司馬宇文士及權檢校侍中。

translations.literal: Yuwen Shiji, marshal of the Heavenly Stratagem General's headquarters, was made acting Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Shiji, marshal of the Heavenly Stratagem headquarters, was appointed acting Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，至自宜州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, he returned from Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, he came back from Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 武德九年九年春正月丙寅，命州縣修城隍，備突厥。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Wude, in the spring of the first month, on bingyin, he ordered prefectures and counties to repair walls and moats in preparation against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Wude, on bingyin of the first spring month, he ordered every prefecture and county to repair its defenses against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射、魏國公裴寂為司空。

translations.literal: Pei Ji, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Duke of Wei, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Ji, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Duke of Wei, was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，加齊王元吉為司徒。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengshen, Prince of Qi Yuan Ji was additionally made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen, Prince of Qi Yuan Ji was also made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，親祠社稷。

translations.literal: On wuyin he personally sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he offered sacrifice at the altars of soil and grain in person.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，幸昆明池。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinmao, he visited Kunming Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinmao, he went to Kunming Pool.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛巳，以京師寺觀不甚清凈，詔曰：

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on xinsi, because the temples and monasteries of the capital were not altogether pure, an edict was issued:
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month, on xinsi, finding the capital's temples and monasteries less than pure, he issued an edict:

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，秦王以皇太子建成與齊王元吉同謀害己，率兵誅之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengshen, the Prince of Qin, on the ground that Crown Prince Jiancheng and Prince of Qi Yuan Ji had plotted together to harm him, led troops and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, the Prince of Qin, claiming that Crown Prince Jiancheng and Prince of Qi Yuan Ji had conspired to kill him, marched out and put them to death.

sentences.zh: 詔立秦王為皇太子，繼統萬機，大赦天下。

translations.literal: An edict installed the Prince of Qin as crown prince to take charge of all affairs; a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: By edict the Prince of Qin was made crown prince and given the reins of government; the empire received a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，詔傳位於皇太子。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guihai, an edict transferred the throne to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai, an edict ceded the throne to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 尊帝為太上皇，徙居弘義宮，改名太安宮。

translations.literal: The emperor was honored as Retired Emperor, moved to Hongyi Palace, which was renamed Tai'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu was styled Retired Emperor, removed to Hongyi Palace—renamed Tai'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 貞觀八年三月甲戌，高祖宴西突厥使者於兩儀殿，顧謂長孫無忌曰：「當今蠻夷率服，古未嘗有。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhenguan, in the third month, on jiaxu, Gaozu entertained envoys of the Western Turks in the Hall of Two Principles and, turning to Zhangsun Wuji, said: "Today the barbarians all submit—never has antiquity seen the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhenguan, on jiaxu of the third month, Gaozu feasted Western Turk envoys in the Hall of Two Principles and said to Zhangsun Wuji: "Never in antiquity have all the outer peoples submitted as they do today.

sentences.zh: 」無忌上千萬歲壽。

translations.literal: " Wuji offered the toast of ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: " Wuji raised the toast wishing him ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 高祖大悅，以酒賜太宗。

translations.literal: Gaozu was greatly pleased and bestowed wine upon Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu was delighted and sent wine to Taizong.

sentences.zh: 太宗又奉觴上壽，流涕而言曰：「百姓獲安，四夷咸附，皆奉遵聖旨，豈臣之力！

translations.literal: Taizong in turn raised his cup and offered long life, weeping as he said: "The common people are at peace and the four quarters all attach themselves—this is all in obedience to your holy instruction; how could it be my doing!
translations.idiomatic: Taizong raised his cup in turn, weeping: "The people are safe and the four quarters submit—all because they follow your command. What is that to my credit?

sentences.zh: 」於是太宗與文德皇后互進御膳，並上服御衣物，一同家人常禮。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Taizong and Empress Wende each served imperial dishes to the other, and together presented robes and personal goods, observing the ordinary rites of a family.
translations.idiomatic: " Then Taizong and Empress Wende served one another from the imperial table, offered clothing and personal gifts, and behaved with the easy manners of kin.

sentences.zh: 是歲，閱武於城西，高祖親自臨視，勞將士而還。

translations.literal: That year a military review was held west of the city; Gaozu watched in person, rewarded the troops, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: That year troops were reviewed west of the city; Gaozu watched in person, praised the soldiers, and returned.

sentences.zh: 置酒於未央宮，三品已上咸侍。

translations.literal: A banquet was set in Weiyang Palace; all officials of the third rank and above attended.
translations.idiomatic: He gave a banquet in Weiyang Palace; every official of the third rank and above was in attendance.

sentences.zh: 高祖命突厥頡利可汗起舞，又遣南越酋長馮智戴詠詩，既而笑曰：「胡、越一家，自古未之有也。

translations.literal: Gaozu ordered Jieli Khan of the Turks to dance, and also had Feng Zhidai, chieftain of the Southern Yue, recite a poem; then he laughed and said: "Hu and Yue as one household—never before in antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu had Jieli Khan of the Turks dance and Feng Zhidai, a Southern Yue chieftain, recite verse; then he laughed: "Turk and Yue under one roof—nothing like it in all history.

sentences.zh: 」太宗奉觴上壽曰：「臣早蒙慈訓，教以文道；

translations.literal: " Taizong raised his cup and offered long life, saying: "Your subject early received your kindly instruction and was taught the way of letters;
translations.idiomatic: " Taizong raised his cup and said: "I was raised in your kindness and taught the way of culture;

sentences.zh: 爰從義旗，平定京邑。

translations.literal: then I followed the righteous banner and pacified the capital.
translations.idiomatic: then I followed the righteous banner and secured the capital.

sentences.zh: 重以薛舉、武周、世充、建德，皆上稟睿算，幸而克定。

translations.literal: Again, against Xue Ju, Wu Zhou, Shichong, and Jiande—all rested on your far-seeing plans, and by fortune were overcome.
translations.idiomatic: Against Xue Ju, Liu Wuzhou, Wang Shichong, and Dou Jiande—each victory rested on your foresight alone.

sentences.zh: 三數年間，混一區宇。

translations.literal: Within two or three years the realm was united.
translations.idiomatic: In two or three years the realm was united.

sentences.zh: 天慈崇寵，遂蒙重任。

translations.literal: Heaven's kindness heaped favor upon me, and I received a weighty charge.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's grace raised me up and laid a heavy charge upon me.

sentences.zh: 今上天垂祐，時和歲阜，被發左衽，並為臣妾。

translations.literal: Now Heaven blesses us; the seasons are mild and the harvest rich; those who wear their hair loose and fasten their robes to the left have all become subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Now Heaven blesses us with peace and plenty, and peoples who once bound their hair and wore robes left-open all bow as subjects.

sentences.zh: 此豈臣智力，皆由上稟聖算。

translations.literal: How could this be my wit or strength? It all proceeds from your sacred planning.
translations.idiomatic: None of this is my wit or strength—it all flows from your design.

sentences.zh: 」高祖大悅，群臣皆呼萬歲，極夜方罷。

translations.literal: " Gaozu was greatly pleased; the assembled ministers all shouted "Ten thousand years!" and only at deep night did the revel end.
translations.idiomatic: " Gaozu was overjoyed; the court shouted "Long live the emperor!" until deep night before the feast broke up.

sentences.zh: 九年五月庚子，高祖大漸，下詔：「既殯之後，皇帝宜於別所視軍國大事。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, in the fifth month, on gengzi, Gaozu fell gravely ill and issued an edict: "After the encoffining, the emperor should conduct state and military affairs at a separate place.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on gengzi of the fifth month, Gaozu fell mortally ill and decreed: "After my body is encoffined, the emperor should handle state and military affairs elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 其服輕重，悉從漢制，以日易月。

translations.literal: As to the weight of mourning garments, let all follow Han practice, substituting days for months.
translations.idiomatic: Let mourning garments follow Han usage, counting days in place of months.

sentences.zh: 園陵制度，務從儉約。

translations.literal: The regulations for the park-tomb should strive for thrift.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb park should be kept spare.

sentences.zh: 」是日，崩於太安宮之垂拱前殿，年七十。

translations.literal: " That same day he died in the Qian Hall of the forward palace at Tai'an Palace, aged seventy.
translations.idiomatic: " That same day he died in the Qian Hall at Tai'an Palace, aged seventy.

sentences.zh: 群臣上謚曰大武皇帝，廟號高祖。

translations.literal: The assembled ministers submitted a posthumous title of Emperor Dawu; his temple name was Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers proposed the posthumous title Emperor Dawu and the temple name Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 十月庚寅，葬於獻陵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on gengyin, he was buried at Xian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengyin, he was interred at Xian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 高宗上元元年八月，改上尊號曰神堯皇帝。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Shangyuan under Gaozong, his elevated honorific was changed to Emperor Shenyao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Shangyuan 1 under Emperor Gaozong, his honorific was raised to Emperor Shenyao.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載二月，上尊號神堯大聖大光孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirteenth year of Tianbao, the honorific Emperor Shenyao the Great Sage, Greatly Glorious and Filial was conferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tianbao 13 he received the honorific Emperor Shenyao the Great Sage, Greatly Glorious and Filial.

sentences.zh: 【史評】史臣曰：有隋季年，皇圖板蕩，荒主燀燎原之焰，群盜發逐鹿之機，殄暴無厭，橫流靡救。

translations.literal: [Historian's appraisal] The historian says: In the closing years of Sui the imperial design was torn apart; a reckless ruler fed a flame across the dry plain, and bandits everywhere seized the moment of the deer hunt—cruelty without end, a flood none could stem.
translations.idiomatic: [Historian's appraisal] The historian writes: In Sui's last years the throne shook apart. A reckless ruler spread fire across the plain; rebels everywhere seized the hunt. Cruelty knew no limit, and the flood could not be stayed.

sentences.zh: 高祖審獨夫之運去，知新主之勃興，密運雄圖，未伸龍躍。

translations.literal: Gaozu saw that the lone tyrant's mandate was spent and knew a new lord was rising; he secretly turned his great design, yet had not yet leapt as the dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu saw the tyrant's hour had passed and a new lord was rising. He nursed a great design in secret, though the dragon had not yet sprung.

sentences.zh: 而屈己求可汗之援，卑辭答李密之書，決神機而速若疾雷，驅豪傑而從如偃草。

translations.literal: Yet he humbled himself to seek the khan's aid and answered Li Mi's letter in low phrases; when he moved his divine reckoning it was swift as thunder, and when he drove heroes they bent like grass before the wind.
translations.idiomatic: He humbled himself for the khan's help and answered Li Mi in courteous phrases; when he struck, his plans moved like thunder, and heroes bent to him like grass in the wind.

sentences.zh: 洎謳謠允屬，揖讓受終，刑名大刬於煩苛，爵位不逾於珝軸。

translations.literal: When the songs of praise were settled he received the abdication; penal names were greatly pared from oppressive detail, and noble ranks did not exceed the cap-box.
translations.idiomatic: When the people's voice settled on him he took the throne by abdication; he slashed penal law to its essentials and kept enfeoffments no larger than a cap-box.

sentences.zh: 由是攫金有恥，伏莽知非，人懷漢道之寬平，不責高皇之慢罵。

translations.literal: Hence those who snatched gold felt shame, and those who lurked in the thickets knew their wrong; men cherished the Han way's breadth and ease and did not reproach Gaozu for coarse speech.
translations.idiomatic: Men who seized gold felt shame; outlaws in the wild knew themselves in the wrong. The people cherished the broad Han way and did not begrudge Gaozu his rough tongue.

sentences.zh: 然而優柔失斷，浸潤得行，誅文靜則議法不從，酬裴寂則曲恩太過。

translations.literal: Yet he was irresolute where he should have decided, and slander gained ground; when he executed Wen Jing the law officers would not agree, and when he rewarded Pei Ji his private favor went too far.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he wavered where he should have cut clean, and slander found room to work. He put Wen Jing to death against the law officers' counsel, and heaped favor on Pei Ji beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 奸佞由之貝錦，嬖幸得以掇蜂。

translations.literal: Through this the treacherous wove their brocade of lies, and favorites could stir the hive.
translations.idiomatic: Flatterers wove their brocade of lies, and favorites stirred the hive.

sentences.zh: 獻公遂間於申生，小白寧懷於召忽。

translations.literal: Duke Xian turned against Shensheng; Duke Huan of Qi still grieved for Zhao Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Like Duke Xian turning on Prince Shensheng, like Duke Huan still mourning Zhao Wu.

sentences.zh: 一旦兵交愛子，矢集申孫。

translations.literal: In a single morning arms clashed between father and beloved son, and arrows clustered on the heir.
translations.idiomatic: One morning father and beloved son met in arms, and arrows rained upon the heir.

sentences.zh: 匈奴尋犯於便橋，京邑咸憂於左衽。

translations.literal: Soon the Xiongnu struck at Bian Bridge, and the capital feared the left-fastening robe.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Turks struck at Bian Bridge, and the capital feared the barbarian at the gate.

sentences.zh: 不有聖子，王業殆哉！

translations.literal: Without a sage son, the royal enterprise would have been in peril!
translations.idiomatic: Without a sage son, the throne would have tottered!

sentences.zh: 【贊】贊曰：高皇創圖，勢若摧枯。

translations.literal: [Eulogy] The eulogy says: The High Emperor founded the design; his force was like snapping dry wood.
translations.idiomatic: [Eulogy] The eulogy says: The High Emperor drew the design; his power snapped kingdoms like dry wood.

sentences.zh: 國運神武，家難聖謨。

translations.literal: The nation's fortune was martial and divine; the house's trial required a sage stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's fortune was fierce and bright; the clan's ordeal called for a sage heir's counsel.

sentences.zh: 言生床笫，禍切肌膚。

translations.literal: Words born beside the bed; calamity cut to the skin.
translations.idiomatic: Words born in the bedchamber; harm that cut to the bone.

sentences.zh: 《鴟鴞》之詠，無損於吾。

translations.literal: The ode of the Owl—yet it did not diminish us.
translations.idiomatic: Even the Owl ode could not diminish us.
